findings.F1: write.participants=off (default): a fact mined from a private turn of a multi-party namespace carries no visibility tag and is served to a non-participant. The workload sets write.participants=session; isolation.viewer_required alone does not protect derived records.
findings.F2: privacy.erasure_v2 hides dependants for re-derivation but keeps their rows and their WRITE events, which still carry the erased text on disk (not served by any read). Replay reproduces exactly that set.
findings.F3: A kept dependant (another live support parent) still lists the erased id in source.parents; the lineage table edge is removed. An id, no text.
findings.F4: Engine.verify_forget()['clean'] is False under erasure_v2 whenever a dependant row is retained (descendants_remaining); it is not erasure_v2-aware.
findings.F5: Memory.retrieve() with a handle purpose raised TypeError (fixed in src/memspine/api/handle.py).

profile: embedded (SQLite, hash embedder, stub LLM roles)

not_rebuilt: model-derived records (L2, L4, L5, unlogged L1)
